name: UK Web Archive
tier_rationale: National library of the United Kingdom (public body, A8 trusted); P059 'All archives are established non-profits or public bodies: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Captures are faithful records of what was served at capture time; the online service has been in maintenance since the 2023 cyberattack.

cdx.title: UK Web Archive CDX (wayback/archive/cdx)
cdx.notes: UKWA stays disabled until it answers (P059 cond 3, cond 10): https://www.webarchive.org.uk/wayback/archive/cdx?url={url}&output=json answered 403 'Under Maintenance' (Azure Front Door) on 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-26, so its terms page could not be reviewed: class 'unknown' (disabled in every licence profile, A1) until legal records them. Research C0186 noted 'Free (British Library)'.
